description:
Goal: no value is built during a compile only to be tested, counted, walked once or copied back to an id that already exists.

Evidence: one compile of dbg(OptionParser.parse(["--s1","5"], strict: [s1: :integer])) on develop 742e688b5 makes 1,561,029 heap allocations (counting allocator, 1 in 16 sampled with call stacks). Ranked sites and call chains: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-j5n-Workspace-fz/464fcf92-8f92-4767-a8fb-4e4eea4b6d45/scratchpad/census/d1_top120.txt, /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-j5n-Workspace-fz/464fcf92-8f92-4767-a8fb-4e4eea4b6d45/scratchpad/census/d1.pkl with /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-j5n-Workspace-fz/464fcf92-8f92-4767-a8fb-4e4eea4b6d45/scratchpad/census/chain.py; source at the measured commit: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-j5n-Workspace-fz/464fcf92-8f92-4767-a8fb-4e4eea4b6d45/scratchpad/census/wt-alloc/src. The child tickets cover about 540k of those allocations. All counts are sampling estimates and the fz-53f epic is moving the same numbers, so every ticket re-measures.

Method per ticket:
1. Read the named sites on the ticket's base and confirm each claim (the coordinator re-measures; see Signal).
2. Find the line that asks for the allocation (the census site is the innermost frame; the request is up the chain).
3. Remove the request: answer the question without building the value, read through a borrow, build once outside the loop, or return the id that already exists. Prefer removing a copy or a concept over adding a cache.
4. Delete what the change makes unused.

Signal per ticket: full gate green; no golden, census or pin moves; program output and canonical backend dump identical on the probe; total allocation count on the probe before and after reported in the commit (the coordinator measures at landing with /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-j5n-Workspace-fz/464fcf92-8f92-4767-a8fb-4e4eea4b6d45/scratchpad/census/measure.sh <commit>, which prints allocation calls, bytes and the md5 of the program output and canonical backend dump; baseline at develop d0c3ae00c: 1,499,268 calls, 270,801,040 bytes; builders do not instrument).

Not in scope (owned by fz-53f / fz-xcu): OrderedSet internals, emptiness Memo.in_flight, interner double storage, ActivationSymbol identity, callsite_call_args family, atom_names per macro run, the hasher, re-keying fact/product/dependency tables.
title: A compile allocates only what it keeps
